trained_on.grid: 12x12 cells over the California bbox, land-masked

notes: Logistic regression trained on (grid cell, day) pairs: was a VIIRS fire detected in that specific cell that day, given that cell's own weather (temp, wind, precipitation, humidity) that day. This gives genuine spatial contrast, unlike a whole-region daily aggregate. At inference time the same model is evaluated against each map grid point's live forecast weather.
